paragraphs.text: Beatriz Ugalde Frausto participated in Seizure REX-11-02 on 2011-12-23. Pacto del Faro Gris was linked to Seizure REX-11-02 on 2011-12-23. Seizure REX-11-02 occurred at Reynosa on 2011-12-23. A bar owner in Reynosa with regular contact among the river crews reported that inspectors seized 210 kg of cannabis from the light aircraft the Gulf crews call Avioneta Faro Chico after it landed at a strip outside Reynosa, and that the crews attributed the load to Ugalde, a logistics figure for Pacto del Faro Gris known as El Cenzontle. The owner stated that the aircraft's paperwork named a guesthouse firm, Posada Arroyo Pardo, as the operator.

Posada Arroyo Pardo supported Seizure REX-11-02 on 2011-12-23. Avioneta Faro Chico was involved in Seizure REX-11-02 on 2011-12-23. Seizure REX-11-02 transited Reynosa plaza on 2011-12-23. The owner stated that the guesthouse firm had provided the paperwork for several of the pact's flights and that the crews expected it to be abandoned after the seizure. The owner characterized the Reynosa plaza as the pact's own at this time, with the river crossings run by its people.

Ignacio Treviño Salcido led Pacto del Faro Gris from 2011-01-22 until 2016-03-09. The owner described Treviño as the head of the pact and stated that the loss of the aircraft was expected to cause friction with the Tampico crew that had been using it. The reporting office assesses the owner as having good access to crew conversations and no direct observation of the seizure. The quantity reported here is the figure given by the crews and has not been verified against the seizure record. The reporting office continues to collect on the guesthouse firm.
